Ava (Sales): PrismPay just locked in a proposed commit. They want reserved GPUs + autoscale for marketing spikes, plus answers to their security questionnaire by Friday. Can ENG + Sec produce sizing + checklist?
Alex (PrismPay): Quick profile: sustained 150 RPS during day, occasional marketing-driven spikes to 1k RPS for ~3-7m. Avg tokens per request ~120 (40 in / 80 out). Target 95p latency <600ms for chat. We will send questionnaire and confirm PHI/no-PHI.
Marta (Solutions Eng): Quick calc: 150 * 120 = 18k tokens/sec sustained. Measured throughput for open-llm-1-xl (quantized route) ~25k tok/s per A10G-equivalent with batch + warm KV. So sustained needs ~1 GPU baseline but recommend reserved 2 GPUs for headroom and KV warm. Spike to 1k -> ~8-9 GPUs if everything hits full model. Options:
- Plan 1: Reserve 2 GPUs + autoscale to 9 for spikes (recommended preheat windows and burst slots).
- Plan 2: Reserve 4 GPUs (more predictable) + autoscale to 9 only if >500 RPS.
Which is cheaper vs predictable? PrismPay, thoughts?
Alex (PrismPay): Prefer predictable but want to avoid overcommit cost. Likely lean Plan 1 if we can guarantee preheat.
Diego (Infra PM): Preheat/KV strategy: targeted prefix warmers + scheduled synthetic sessions. Suggested preheat cadence: 15m before business start, and 10m prior to known campaign blasts (they can trigger webhooks). Cooldown: maintain min_replicas for 10m post-spike to avoid thrash. Example autoscale policy (YAML):
```yaml
policy: rps_based
min_replicas: 2
max_replicas: 9
scale_up:
  threshold_rps: 220
  eval_period_s: 30
  cooldown_s: 60
scale_down:
  threshold_rps: 180
  eval_period_s: 60
  cooldown_s: 600
metrics:
  - name: moving_avg_rps
    window_s: 60
  - name: queue_depth
    window_s: 30
```
Nina (Security): Questionnaire checklist (high level): network diagram, VPC peering options, ingress/egress rules, TLS 1.2+/mTLS for service-to-service, KMS CMK ownership, RBAC + SSO integration, retention & deletion policy, audit log access, SOC2 artifact links, incident response contact. If they have PHI -> Private deployment required (adds ~2 weeks to onboarding). Need to know: PHI? AWS KMS vs customer HSM?
Alex (PrismPay): No PHI in current scope. We'll use AWS KMS (CMKs). Legal contact is lisa.k@prismpay.com. Questionnaire link: https://prismpay-sec.example/q/prismpay-redwood-2026
Marta (Solutions Eng): Great. I'll assemble a one-page with the sizing math, two plan options (2+burst vs 4 reserved), autoscale YAML, KV preheat checklist, and a sample cost band. Quick cost note (ballpark): reserved 2x baseline cost vs reserved 4x ~ x2 baseline; bursting to 9 will add transient cost. I'll get finance to model commit discounts.
Diego (Infra PM): Operational runbook items I'll add: AZ spread for reserved GPUs, preheat job (k8s cronjob or external webhook), smoke test endpoints, slot reservation notes (how burst slots map to billing), and eviction fallback (on spot preempt -> route to quantized model).
Nina (Security): I'll draft questionnaire responses for their link and flag the few items we need filled (service-to-service IP allowlist, logs retention window). Also add suggested obfuscation for any PII in warm samples.
deploy-bot: scheduled smoke test: prismpay-sustained-150rps -> 2026-04-02T09:00Z assigned to @Marta @Diego
Marta (Solutions Eng): Fallbacks: suggest a cold-fallback policy to a smaller quantized model (8-bit) during aggressive spot evictions or if autoscale lags. We'll include perf delta table (latency vs quality) and a suggested A/B rollout.
Alex (PrismPay): We'll provide campaign schedule hooks and can trigger preheat webhooks 15m before blasts. We'll also upload a redacted sample payload for KV warming.
Ava (Sales): Timeline: draft by Tue COB, internal review Wed, share with customer Thu morning, final answers by Fri. Action owners: Marta -> sizing + one-pager; Diego -> preheat runbook + autoscale YAML; Nina -> questionnaire draft; Ava -> coordinate legal (Lisa). Alex -> questionnaire + sample payload + webhook schedule.
Marta (Solutions Eng): Noted. I'll include sample synthetic load commands and reproduction steps (wrk + custom prompt generator).
Diego (Infra PM): Also adding recommended monitoring alerts: sustained > scale_up threshold for 3 windows, high queue depth, and high token generation error rate.
Nina (Security): One more ask: confirm retention window (how long sessions are kept) and deletion SLA. Alex?
Alex (PrismPay): We keep sessions 30 days by default; can accept shorter for compliance if needed. Lisa will confirm.
Ava (Sales): Thanks team. Keep docs customer-facing (one-pager) with ops appendix. I'll ping here when Lisa responds. :raised_hands:
